map.计算矿车装载量、循环时间、班产能力与所需矿车数量，优化运输效率: Compute mine cart loading, cycle time, shift capacity and the number of carts required, optimising haulage efficiency
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：shiftMinutes × utilization: Core formula (by input variables): shiftMinutes × utilization ÷ 100
map.= 装载 + 重车运行 + 卸载 + 空车返回 + 等待: = loading + loaded travel + dumping + empty return + waiting
map.= 班运输总量 ÷ 单车班产量（向上取整）: = total haulage per shift ÷ output per cart per shift (rounded up)
map.装载系数过低说明矿车未装满，可优化装载方式: A low loading factor means the cart is not filled, so loading method can be improved
map.等待时间占比高说明调度需优化，可增加会让站或优化班次: A high waiting time share means dispatch needs optimising; add passing bays or adjust shifts
map.设备利用率低于 70% 时需排查故障或待料原因: When equipment utilisation falls below 70%, investigate faults or waiting for material
map.矿车数与电铲数需匹配，避免\"车等铲\"或\"铲等车\": The number of carts and loaders must be matched to avoid "carts waiting for loader" or "loader waiting for carts"

map.配车计算：已知班产量、作业时长与单车参数，求最少所需矿车数，并看能力裕量。: Fleet sizing: given shift output, working duration and per-cart parameters, find the minimum number of carts required and look at the capacity margin.
map.效率诊断：分析装载系数、等待时间、设备利用率，定位运输瓶颈并给优化提示。: Efficiency diagnosis: analyse loading factor, waiting time and equipment utilisation to locate the haulage bottleneck and get optimisation tips.
map.方案比选：调整循环时间（如缩短等待/倒车）看车辆需求与产能利用率变化。: Scheme comparison: adjust cycle time (such as shortening waiting or reversing) and see how vehicle demand and capacity utilisation change.
map.实际载重=车厢容量×装载系数；循环时间=装车+重车运行+卸车+空车返回+等待；有: Actual load=carriage capacity×loading factor; cycle time=loading+loaded travel+dumping+empty return+waiting; effective working time=shift hours×utilisation/100; trips per shift=effective time/cycle; output per cart per shift=trips×actual load; carts required=ceil(shift output/output per cart); capacity margin=(total capacity−shift output)/shift output; effective running ratio=(load+travel+dump+return)/cycle×100.
map.班产量 1500 t、班时 480 min、车厢 20 t、装载系数 0.9、装: Shift output 1500 t, shift time 480 min, carriage 20 t, loading factor 0.9, load 5 / travel 12 / dump 3 / return 10 / wait 3 min, utilisation 75%. Actual load 18 t, cycle 33 min, effective 360 min, trips 10.909, output per cart 196.36 t, carts needed ceil(1500/196.36)=8, total capacity 1570.9 t, margin 4.73%, effective running ratio 90.9%.
map.边界：车数取整与裕量: Boundary: cart count rounding and margin
map.所需车数向上取整（7.64→8），第 8 辆常未满载，故裕量偏小（4.73%）。: The required cart count is rounded up (7.64→8), and the 8th cart is often not fully loaded, so the margin looks small (4.73%). If utilisation drops to 70% or the waiting share exceeds 15%, the cart count rises sharply; slight fluctuation can turn "just enough" into "not enough", so configure 1–2 carts of margin.
map.利用率 75% 已不低，为什么还要留车数裕量？: Utilisation of 75% is already decent — why still leave a margin?
map.循环时间是平均值，实际有装车排队、路面、交接班等随机波动；75% 利用率下有效运: Cycle time is an average, and in reality there are random fluctuations from loading queues, road conditions and shift handovers; at 75% utilisation the effective running ratio is 90.9%, leaving about 9% as non-productive time. After rounding the 8th cart often runs partly empty so the margin is only 4.73%, and any delay could leave the shift short, so sites normally add 1–2 carts to absorb fluctuation.
map.等待时间占比高说明什么？: What does a high waiting time share indicate?
map.等待>循环 15% 通常指向调度或装卸点瓶颈（如单车等挖机、卸车位不足）。优化方: Waiting above 15% of the cycle usually points to a dispatch or loading/unloading point bottleneck (such as a cart waiting for the excavator, or too few dumping positions). The optimisation direction is to add loading/dumping points, stagger dispatch or balance the cycle stages, rather than simply adding carts — which can actually worsen queuing.
